title: payment-object
description: This object is required for payment flow_type. Contains parameters pertaining to payment details.

avs-object.title: avs
avs-object.description: The avs object can be added to the request to initiate a payment with a third-party bank account validation. AVS is supported for the card (debit card), netbanking and upi payment methods.

bankaccounts.description: Object that contains the details of the payment method

ifsc.description: IFSC of the bank account number

name.description: Name of the bank account holder

max_payments_allowed.title: max_payments_allowed
max_payments_allowed.description: Only applicable in case partial payment allowed is true. Maximum number of partial payments that can be processed on the same link. This can be a maximum value of 10 (successful transactions).

minimum_partial_amount.title: minimum_partial_amount
minimum_partial_amount.description: Minimum amount that is required to be paid for every partial payment. Applicable when partial payment allowed is true. If not passed, default value will be set to 1.00

partial_payment_allowed.title: partial_payment_allowed
partial_payment_allowed.description: To determine if partial payment is allowed on the link against the total amount used for link creation.
